summary: Frontend-only verification of SQL IDE mode toggles, company logo glow, mode badge strip, and expanded (45) question banks across all 5 modules. All requested features work as specified. No console errors, no import failures, no crashes. All data-testid selectors from the review resolve correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: SQLPage.jsx is 810 lines — approaching the 700-line file-size guideline. Consider extracting the top brand bar / hero-mode-selector / company selector into a dedicated <SqlIdeHeader/> component and the ModeTab + MODE_META into src/components/SqlModeSelector.jsx to improve maintainability.

Company logos are loaded from cdn.simpleicons.org over HTTPS with hardcoded color hex in the URL. This is fine functionally but adds a runtime dependency on an external CDN. If the CDN is down the segmented company buttons render only the fallback emoji — consider adding fallback to the emoji explicitly, or self-host the 5 SVGs.

learning-lock toast fires correctly, but two identical toasts were captured on a single next-question click (deduped copy in DOM). Verify toast provider isn't rendering both the live region AND the visible toast as separate matches — cosmetic but worth checking to avoid double-announce for screen readers.

Stats module now shows '/ 47' rather than '/ 45' because 2 AI-generated questions from iteration-2 test runs remain persisted in db.ai_questions and are merged into the sidebar. This is intended (AI + seed union) but if the QA counter contract is strictly 'seed / 45', the seed count and AI count should be displayed separately (e.g. '0/45 seed · +2 AI') to avoid confusion in future test runs.
companies.js: UBER.logoUrl uses white (FFFFFF) which is correct for a dark theme but will be invisible on any light-mode theme toggle. Consider theme-aware logo color.
test_credentials: n/a — logged-out flows only per review request.
seed_data_creation: None. Note: 2 AI stats questions persist in db.ai_questions from iteration-2, causing Stats page counter to show /47 instead of /45 (see comment above — intended merge behavior).

Question banks: excel/sql/python/stats/powerbi arrays each contain 45 questions with distribution 17 beginner / 17 intermediate / 11 advanced (verified via node -e). Stats displays /47 due to legacy AI questions in db — clear db.ai_questions collection if a strict /45 count is required.
